name: Command Palette — Vercel
description: Refined dark monochrome Cmd+K command palette with hairline borders, a subtle radial glow, and a single teal accent. Live search filters grouped commands, arrow keys move the highlight, Enter runs the selected command with a confirmation toast, Escape closes, and Cmd/Ctrl+K toggles open. Focus is trapped inside the palette and restored to the trigger on close.
features: dark monochrome surface with hairline borders
single teal accent and radial glow
live search filtering across grouped commands
Enter runs command with confirmation toast
focus trap while open, focus restore on close
role dialog and role option with aria-selected
